title: Validate collaboration values
responsibility: Define collaboration schemas and shared parsing, hashing and path checks.

inputs.name: fail.code
inputs.description: Machine-readable failure code attached to the thrown error.

inputs.name: parseCollaborationInput.schema
inputs.description: Zod schema used to validate and transform the value.

inputs.name: digest.algorithm
inputs.description: WebCrypto digest algorithm; defaults to SHA-256.

inputs.name: safePath.value
inputs.description: Repository-relative path without empty or dot segments, backslashes or control characters.

outputs.name: label
outputs.description: Schema that trims text and requires 1–200 characters.

outputs.name: email
outputs.description: Email schema limited to 320 characters and normalized to lowercase.

outputs.name: actorSchema
outputs.description: Strict verified-actor schema with ID, email, name and emailVerified true.

outputs.name: repositorySchema
outputs.description: Strict repository schema with positive numeric repository and installation IDs, owner, name and privacy flag.

outputs.name: branch
outputs.description: Branch-name schema limited to 1–255 characters with forbidden Git-ref patterns rejected.

outputs.name: entityId
outputs.description: Harness unit-ID schema limited to 240 characters.

outputs.name: anchorSchema
outputs.description: Strict anchor schema binding branch, commit and entity to optional version, image, state, viewport and normalized image region.

outputs.name: fail
outputs.description: Always throws an Error carrying the supplied code.

outputs.name: parseCollaborationInput
outputs.description: Validated and transformed value; also exported under the alias parse.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Parsing failures use invalid-input, unsafe paths use invalid-path, and fail uses the supplied code; WebCrypto failures can propagate.
